title: Pawn chains and pawn breaks
intro: Pawns that lock the centre decide the plans. Learn to attack a pawn chain with a pawn break.

lessons.title: Attack the pawn chain
lessons.summary: Strike at the head or the base with a pawn.

steps.text: White's pawns on d4 and e5 form a chain: d4 (the base) protects e5 (the head). Black's pieces cannot attack them easily, so Black uses pawns.

A pawn break attacks the chain with a pawn. Usually ...c5 hits the base on d4, but here Black's c-pawn is already gone. So the break is ...f6: it hits the head on e5 and opens the f-file for Black's rook.
Break the chain: attack the e5 pawn with a pawn and open a file for your rook.
steps.hint: Your f-pawn can reach a square that attacks e5.
steps.ifWrong: Use a pawn to attack e5.
steps.ifRight: If White takes on f6, your rook on f8 gets an open file.
